instruction.name: vmadd.d
instruction.description: Multiply 64-bit elements in `b` and `c`, add the low 64 bits of the product to elements in `a`, save the result in `dst`.

experiments.name: accumulator dependency chain
experiments.notes: Destination is also the accumulator; this measures the accumulator-to-result path.
